scripts.seed: tsx -e "import('dotenv/config'); import('./server/db.ts').then(m => m.connectDB()).then(() => import('./server/seed.ts')).then(s => s.seedDatabase()).then(() => process.exit(0))"
scripts.create-super-admin: tsx -e "import('dotenv/config'); import('./server/db.ts').then(m => m.connectDB()).then(() => import('./server/seed.ts')).then(s => s.ensureSuperAdmin()).then(() => process.exit(0))"
